AttributeDescription: The identifier originally assigned to a sample by collecting party or sample submitter. Values may not be unique in this database.
Unique identifier assigned to each submitted sample by USGS Analytical Chemistry Sample Control.
Latitude coordinate of sample site, reported in decimal degrees; converted, if necessary, to WGS84 datum.
Longitude coordinate of sample site, reported in decimal degrees; converted, if necessary, to WGS84 datum.
Radius (in meters) of positional-uncertainty envelope of the sample location.
The specific rock name assigned by the collector based on initial field observations.
Geologic age or age range for a rock sample.
Laboratory codes for the analytical methods used to analyze the sample. Multiple laboratory codes separated by semicolons.

Arsenic, in parts per million by weight, determined by inductively coupled plasma (ICP) emission spectrometry methods, including atomic emission spectrometry (ICP-AES), optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES), and mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) following sodium peroxide fusion. Method codes are C_ICPAES-MS-55, C_ICPOES_MS-60, and C_ICPOES_MS-61. Concentrations less than the Lower Detection Limit (<LDL) are identified with a negative sign (-LDL). Sample solutions with concentrations exceeding the Upper Detection Limit were diluted and reanalyzed to provide an actual concentration value. A blank or NULL value indicates that no data are available.
DescriptionSource: modifed from U.S. Geological Survey, 2021, Geochemical data generated by projects funded by the USGS Earth Mapping Resources Initiative (ver. 11.0, January 2025): U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9WHRLXH.
